```{=html}
<style>
.w093-pairs { max-width: 620px; margin: 0 auto; font-size: 0.92rem; }
.w093-pairs .w093-cols { display: flex; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; align-items: stretch; }
.w093-pairs .w093-col { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
.w093-pairs .w093-terms { flex: 0 0 36%; }
.w093-pairs .w093-defs { flex: 1 1 0; }
.w093-pairs .w093-card {
  padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 8px; text-align: left; font: inherit;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222);
  cursor: pointer; user-select: none; flex: 1 1 auto;
}
.w093-pairs .w093-terms .w093-card { font-weight: 600; }
.w093-pairs .w093-card.w093-sel { outline: 3px solid #d81e2e; outline-offset: 2px; }
.w093-pairs .w093-card.w093-done { opacity: 0.5; cursor: default; border-style: dashed; }
.w093-pairs .w093-card.w093-right { border: 2px solid #2e7d32; border-style: solid; }
.w093-pairs .w093-card.w093-flash { border: 2px solid #d81e2e; }
.w093-pairs .w093-controls { display: flex; gap: 8px; justify-content: center; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.w093-pairs .w093-controls button {
  padding: 5px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222); cursor: pointer;
}
.w093-pairs .w093-note { font-size: 0.78rem; opacity: 0.7; font-style: italic; }
.w093-pairs .w093-msg { font-weight: 700; min-height: 1.4em; text-align: center; margin-top: 0.5rem; }
.w093-pairs .w093-msg.ok { color: #2e7d32; }
.w093-pairs .w093-msg.bad { color: #d81e2e; }
</style>
<div class="iw w093-pairs" id="w093">
  <div class="w093-cols">
    <div class="w093-col w093-terms" aria-label="terms"></div>
    <div class="w093-col w093-defs" aria-label="descriptions"></div>
  </div>
  <div class="w093-controls">
    <button type="button" class="w093-check iw-check">Check</button>
    <button type="button" class="w093-reset iw-reset">Reset</button>
    <button type="button" class="w093-solution iw-solution">Show solution</button>
    <span class="w093-note">(no fun if you click it right away)</span>
  </div>
  <div class="w093-msg iw-msg" role="status"></div>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  const root = document.getElementById('w093');
  const termsCol = root.querySelector('.w093-terms');
  const defsCol = root.querySelector('.w093-defs');
  const msg = root.querySelector('.w093-msg');
  const PAIRS = [
    ['Event', 'Anything that happens in a system or network and can be recorded; most are normal'],
    ['Alert', 'A message that demands attention, raised when events match a rule or pattern signalling a potential threat'],
    ['Telemetry', 'The sources that show what is happening in the environment'],
    ['Canary (honey token)', 'A decoy credential or resource that no legitimate process should touch'],
    ['SIEM', 'A service for correlating logs across the environment'],
    ['CSPM', 'A service for detecting insecure configurations']
  ];
  const DEF_ORDER = [3, 5, 1, 4, 0, 2]; // scrambled display order of descriptions
  let sel = null, matched = 0;
  function clearMsg() { msg.textContent = ''; msg.className = 'w093-msg iw-msg'; }
  function unselect() { if (sel) sel.classList.remove('w093-sel'); sel = null; }
  function make(text, k, kind) {
    const b = document.createElement('button');
    b.type = 'button'; b.className = 'w093-card';
    b.textContent = text; b.dataset.k = k; b.dataset.kind = kind;
    b.addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (b.classList.contains('w093-done')) return;
      clearMsg();
      if (sel === b) { unselect(); return; }
      if (sel && sel.dataset.kind !== kind) {
        const a = sel; unselect();
        if (a.dataset.k === b.dataset.k) {
          a.classList.add('w093-done'); b.classList.add('w093-done'); matched++;
        } else {
          [a, b].forEach(c => { c.classList.add('w093-flash');
            setTimeout(() => c.classList.remove('w093-flash'), 600); });
        }
        return;
      }
      unselect(); sel = b; b.classList.add('w093-sel');
    });
    return b;
  }
  PAIRS.forEach((p, i) => termsCol.appendChild(make(p[0], i, 'term')));
  DEF_ORDER.forEach(i => defsCol.appendChild(make(PAIRS[i][1], i, 'def')));
  const defs0 = [...defsCol.children];
  function resetAll() {
    unselect(); matched = 0;
    root.querySelectorAll('.w093-card').forEach(c =>
      c.classList.remove('w093-done', 'w093-right', 'w093-flash'));
    defs0.forEach(c => defsCol.appendChild(c));
    clearMsg();
  }
  root.querySelector('.w093-check').addEventListener('click', () => {
    clearMsg();
    if (matched === PAIRS.length) {
      root.querySelectorAll('.w093-done').forEach(c => c.classList.add('w093-right'));
      msg.textContent = '✓ All pairs matched — the monitoring vocabulary is in place.';
      msg.classList.add('ok');
    } else if (matched === 0) {
      msg.textContent = 'No pairs matched yet — click a term, then the description that fits it.';
    } else {
      msg.textContent = 'Keep going — ' + matched + ' of ' + PAIRS.length + ' pairs matched (a wrong attempt flashes red).';
    }
  });
  root.querySelector('.w093-reset').addEventListener('click', resetAll);
  root.querySelector('.w093-solution').addEventListener('click', () => {
    resetAll();
    PAIRS.forEach((p, i) => {
      const d = defs0.find(c => +c.dataset.k === i);
      defsCol.appendChild(d);
    });
    root.querySelectorAll('.w093-card').forEach(c => c.classList.add('w093-done', 'w093-right'));
    matched = PAIRS.length;
    msg.textContent = 'Solution shown — reset to try it yourself.';
    msg.classList.add('ok');
  });
})();
</script>
```
